name: How does Frasheski Construction handle permits for bathroom vanity upgrades in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction handle permits for bathroom vanity upgrades in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: For significant bathroom vanity upgrades in Berkeley that involve altering structural elements, moving plumbing lines, or making substantial electrical changes, permits are often required by the City of Berkeley Planning Department. Minor cosmetic updates typically do not require permits. Frasheski Construction will assess your project's scope during the initial consultation and advise on whether permits are necessary. We can assist in navigating the permitting process to ensure all work complies with local building codes and regulations, offering process clarity for our clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually needed for major vanity upgrades (structural, plumbing, electrical changes) in Berkeley; Frasheski Construction can advise and assist with this process.
